typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FilePath as string ()
}

source(output(
		SBSB_ID as string,
		Birth_dt as timestamp,
		STATE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT  SBSB_ID,\'TX\' as STATE,Birth_dt  FROM TX_JP2012 WHERE SENT_TO_FLAG=0',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> GETELIGIBLERECORDS
GETELIGIBLERECORDS split(greaterOrEqual(notConvertedectfunctiondatedatediff('dd', Birth_dt, currentTimestamp()),notConvertedectfunctiondatedatediff('dd', addMonths(currentTimestamp(), 0), currentTimestamp())),notConvertedectfunctiondatedatediff('dd', Birth_dt, currentTimestamp()) < notConvertedectfunctiondatedatediff('dd', addMonths(currentTimestamp(), 0), currentTimestamp()), disjoint: true) ~> COMPARINGAGE@(TXADULT,TXCHILD,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
COMPARINGAGE@TXADULT sink(input(
		STATE as string,
		SBSB_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		STATE,
		SBSB_ID)) ~> VENDORADFILE
COMPARINGAGE@TXCHILD sink(input(
		State as string,
		SBSB_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		State = STATE,
		SBSB_ID)) ~> VENDORPEDIFILE
